# Evidence Fixtures — record-contract pattern gift

Kinocut's record-contract patterns, grafted onto the ResonantOS contribution
economy's own contribution-edge fixtures — proving those fixtures pass with
every effect field held at none: reward_effect, authority_effect,
policy_effect, governance_effect, payout_effect, implementation_status:
fixture_only. A reference engine (Python 3 stdlib only) plus the pattern doc
that teaches the graft. It computes nothing but fixture pass/fail state: not a
token, not a validator of the economy, not an implementation plan.

## Canonical links

- This repo: https://github.com/simongonzalezdc/resonant-evidence-fixtures
- Canonical fixture package (not included, never modified):
  https://github.com/ResonantOS/resonantos-economy-research —
  validation/contribution-edge-fixtures/

## Key facts

- ResonantOS 2.0.0-alpha add-on (loopback local service); validator: 0 errors
  / 0 warnings
- License: Apache-2.0
- Fixture run receipt, not economy validation: deterministic receipt, the
  fixture directory is bit-identical after every run (test-pinned)
- Exit codes: 0 all pass, 1 some fixture failed, 2 fatal (drift or bad dir)

Relationship: community gift by Kyanite Labs for ResonantOS — the fixture
package belongs to the community at
https://github.com/ResonantOS/resonantos-economy-research; this engine is a
non-canonical pattern gift, and the community's fixtures and their own limits
(in their words) win.
